query:
SELECT id, name FROM molecules 
WHERE name LIKE '%Guaiacol%' 
   OR name LIKE '%Pyrazine%' 
   OR name LIKE '%Furfural%' 
   OR name LIKE '%Cresol%' 
   OR name LIKE '%Skatole%'
   OR name LIKE '%Calone%'
   OR name LIKE '%Linalool%'
   OR name LIKE '%Limonene%'
   OR name LIKE '%Pinene%'
   OR name LIKE '%Menthol%'
   OR name LIKE '%Myrcene%'
   OR name LIKE '%Caryophyllene%'
   OR name LIKE '%Humulene%'
   OR name LIKE '%Geosmin%'
   OR name LIKE '%Vetiver%'
   OR name LIKE '%Ambrox%'
   OR name LIKE '%Iso E Super%'
ORDER BY name;
